profile_text.body:
Hesai Group is a Shanghai-headquartered public company, traded under the ticker HSAI, that describes itself on its website as a global leader in 3D perception. The company says it makes lidar sensors for ADAS, autonomous mobility, robotics, and spatial intelligence, and that its lidars serve as the eyes of intelligent vehicles, providing high-resolution 3D perception that enables features such as automated emergency braking (AEB) and navigation on autopilot (NOA). It also states that its sensors meet the standards for L4+ autonomous driving used by robotaxis and robobuses.

According to its site, Hesai partners with automotive OEMs and autonomous vehicle and robotics companies worldwide, and has delivered mass-produced lidars to customers in over 40 countries. The company frames its lidar work as improving safety and performance for the automotive industry and as supporting large-scale deployment of autonomous vehicle fleets.

The company's profile lists it as a for-profit public company headquartered in Shanghai with CIK 0001861737. No litigation, no tracked products, and no MCP servers are recorded for it.
